groups.title: Metal Fabrication
groups.summary: MSM Machine Works also specializes in structural metal fabrication in Houston, TX.
groups.intro: MSM Machine Works also specializes in structural metal fabrication in Houston, TX. We handle everything from welding and cutting to forming and finishing of metal parts. Our in-house custom fabrication solutions address all your project’s needs.

groups.title: Plasma, Waterjet, & Laser Cutting
groups.summary: With plasma, waterjet, and laser cutting, we are able to cut various essential materials in manufacturing, including: steel, stainless steel, aluminum, brass, copper, stone, plastics, wood, fabric, and acrylic. Our precision cutting is capable of trimming up to 6" in thickness. Each method has its ideal use case depending on the job requirements.

groups.title: Pipe & Well Head Fabrication
groups.summary: We provide pipe fabrication and well head fabrication services for the oil and gas industries.
groups.intro: We provide pipe fabrication and well head fabrication services for the oil and gas industries, built to handle high pressure and harsh environments. We cover everything from pipe end preparation and welding to manufacturing base plates, casing heads, spools, tubing heads, adapter bonnets, and more. Call us for an estimate.

groups.title: Prototyping and Bespoke Fabrication
groups.summary: For prototyping or crafting unique parts, our CNC milling services excel in rapid prototyping and custom fabrication, swiftly transforming your designs into physical products. Our ability to prototype quickly supports iterative design processes, conserving both time and resources.

about.title: About MSM Machine Works
text: MSM Machine Works Inc. is a full service fabrication and machining facility located on the East side of Houston, Texas (I-10 East @ Beltway 8).
MSM provides comprehensive fabrication and machining services for a wide range of construction and oilfield specialty products.
It is our objective to be one of the leading suppliers in the precision machining and fabrication industry by producing products of exceptional quality.
